Non-CRR sitemaps byte-identical.

If a merge retires any of them, retarget my row in place to the new winner (the 'no destination is itself a redirect source' test will fail otherwise).

Wire the Block 3 city data gate into isHeldPath() in src/data/held-pages.ts (keep it synchronous; middleware calls it per request). Releasing a page = it stops matching isHeldPath; no template change needed.

After merging lanes, run `node scripts/page-dates.mjs` from Code/Frontend to regenerate src/data/page-modified-dates.ts, then the tests (page-modified-dates.test.ts runs --check). Any lane that changed a page's dateModified, added a hand-written page to the sitemap lists, or rewrote a page's date markup needs this. If --check reports UNREAD for a new page pattern, extend the rules in scripts/page-dates.mjs rather than hard-coding a date.

If you add a Byline to the posts that show only an unlabeled date (T-50/T-51), pass the page's dateModified. Ten of them now show 'Updated <dateModified>' in the old header (this lane); prefer your version on conflict as long as the visible date equals dateModified. Trust pages (/about, /contact, /methodology, /editorial-policy, /how-we-make-money, /sources-we-use, /corrections, /author) declare no date and so get no sitemap lastmod; if you add a dateModified or a 'Last updated: Month D, YYYY' line, rerun page-dates.
